description:
Cross200 21-Speed Step-Through Comfort Hybrid Bike
The Cross200 21-Speed Step-Through Comfort Hybrid Bike is designed for commuting, neighborhood rides, fitness cycling, and everyday recreation. Its lightweight aluminum step-through frame makes getting on and off the bike easy while providing a comfortable upright riding position for riders of all experience levels.

Lightweight Step-Through Aluminum Frame
The lightweight aluminum step-through frame offers easy mounting and dismounting while maintaining responsive handling and long-lasting durability. Its relaxed geometry promotes an upright riding position that helps reduce strain on the back, shoulders, and wrists during longer rides.

Shimano 21-Speed Drivetrain
The Shimano 21-speed drivetrain provides a wide gear range for city streets, bike paths, moderate hills, and recreational rides. Smooth, dependable shifting allows riders to adapt comfortably to changing terrain.

Front Suspension Fork
The suspension fork helps absorb bumps, uneven pavement, and expansion joints, providing a smoother and more comfortable ride for everyday cycling.

Reliable Front and Rear V-Brakes
Front and rear V-brakes deliver dependable stopping performance for commuting, recreational riding, and everyday use in a variety of riding conditions.

700C Hybrid Wheels
The 700C wheels roll efficiently on pavement while remaining comfortable on packed gravel and multi-use paths. Double-wall alloy rims provide added strength and durability for regular riding.

Comfortable for Everyday Riding
An ergonomic saddle and comfort-oriented handlebars support a relaxed riding position, making the Cross200 ideal for commuting, neighborhood rides, fitness cycling, and weekend recreation.

Ideal For

It is designed for everyday transportation and recreation but is not intended for technical mountain biking or aggressive off-road trails.
